target: Bridge the finite unit-circle atomic representation to finite positive Borel measures on C. Prove singular PSD Toeplitz matrices have a unique representing finite unit-circle measure, every full-rank case has distinct measures, and uniqueness is equivalent to rank(T)<=n for size n+1; claim only statements actually proved.
conventions: Positive countably additive Borel measures on C, finite total mass, norm(z)=1 almost everywhere; entry orientation T_ij=integral conj(z^i)*z^j dmu. Atomic measure is sum of ENNReal.ofReal(w(z))*dirac(z). Equality is equality of measures, with no assertion about arbitrary weight values off support.
DH_analogue: The identical statement for any DH-derived matrix satisfying PSD and Toeplitz. No arithmetic PSD premise, actual arithmetic probe, infinite moment sequence or separator is supplied.
status: Preregistered before implementation; only completed statements will be claimed.
